title: SET_CONFIG structure
section: SET_CONFIG / main bundle and PLUGIN_CONFIG BUNDLE
text: SET_CONFIG can configure multiple options with one intent. Its main bundle can contain an array of PLUGIN_CONFIG bundles. Each plugin bundle has its own PARAM_LIST. The PLUGIN_NAME is case sensitive. The documented plugin names include BARCODE input and INTENT output.

title: SET_CONFIG version history
text: SET_CONFIG was introduced in DataWedge 6.4. Support for configuring multiple plugins with one action was added in DataWedge 6.6. For DataWedge 6.5 and below, each plugin needs a separate intent action.

title: Full profile single intent
section: Set configuration for multiple modules (full profile) in a single intent
text: Support for configuring a full profile with multiple modules, including plugins, APP_LIST and Data Capture Plus, in a single intent started with DataWedge 7.1. Earlier versions required multiple intent calls for multiple modules.

title: Programmer's Guide
text: The programmer's guide directs developers to SET_CONFIG to create or update profiles and configure multiple input, processing, output or utility plugins with a single intent.

title: Configuration mode
text: CONFIG_MODE supports CREATE_IF_NOT_EXIST, OVERWRITE and UPDATE. UPDATE requires the profile to exist. OVERWRITE resets options to defaults before applying supplied settings. The chosen mode can affect an existing profile.
